title: Optimal Quantum Algorithm for Ground-State Energy Estimation with a Guiding State
summary: In the problem of ground-state energy estimation, one aims to estimate the smallest eigenvalue of a Hamiltonian, often given a guiding state, with some promised overlap $γ$ with the ground space. The main approach to this problem is to simulate its evolution, and estimate the smallest (or equivalently, largest) eigenphase of the resulting unitary $U$. We give a quantum algorithm that estimates the largest eigenphase of a unitary $U$ in this guided setting using a factor of $\log\frac{1}γ$ fewer queries to $U$ than the previous best approach.
